title: Design: New Customer Payment window is unchanged for the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have two new open invoices for this test billed to customer A, for customer B's and customer C's work, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Start on customer A's Invoices tab.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-08-after-new-customer-payment.png, bt-p5-07-before-new-customer-payment.png, bt-p5-06-after-rows-picked.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Totals selected row shows and New Payment turns solid blue.

Step 2:

  • The New Customer Payment window lists both invoices with No., Date, Due, Balance and Payment, as in production (no Service For column), and Payment amount totals both balances.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R4: “A payment settles only invoices owed by the paying customer; one payment can cover several of its invoices across customers.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "5 Getting paid", pictures "New Customer Payment" (This build), "New Customer Payment" (Production (v26.45.2.1)), "Rows picked" (This build).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p5-08-after-new-customer-payment.png
  • bt-p5-07-before-new-customer-payment.png
  • bt-p5-06-after-rows-picked.png

The design's own words:

  • “The window is unchanged: S2-17362 and S2-17513, Payment amount $1,679.02.”
